acceptance_criteria.condition: V8 preregisters one Agent timeout and one test timeout as immutable protocol inputs before any trial.
The V8 runner rejects a requested timeout that differs from the frozen protocol before delegating any Agent execution.
The V8 planned envelope freezes the installed Harness version and rejects changed, external, symbolic-link, or live-runtime-substituted inputs before any Agent execution.

invariants: No V8 Agent trial begins before the timeout budget, Harness version, and implementation inputs are frozen in a committed preregistration.
Both paired conditions use identical registered Agent and test timeouts.
A timeout mismatch fails before the delegated V6 execution path can create Agent artifacts.
V8 remains planned with an empty trial list until the frozen protocol has been committed.
Formal collection uses only a clean Git worktree at the preregistration commit, rejects input or output symbolic links, and scores from the same staged runtime used for execution.

safeguards.name: immutable timeout budget and Harness
safeguards.rationale: The protocol hash-links explicit Agent and scorer timeout values, runner bytes, and the installed Codex release; the runner compares requested values before execution.

safeguards.name: pre-execution integrity rejection
safeguards.rationale: A parameter, version, committed-byte, tree, symbolic-link, dirty-worktree, or external-input mismatch is rejected before V6 can spawn a Codex process.

safeguards.name: condition parity and frozen runtime reuse
safeguards.rationale: The single registered budget applies equally to baseline and explicit-Skill treatment conditions; --preflight completes without loading the delegated runner, while hidden scoring reuses the staged runner and scorer rather than importing live files.

design_boundary.rationale: The V8 wrapper owns version-specific preregistration validation; the shared V6 runner retains paired execution mechanics.

dependency_audit.rationale: The change uses existing Python standard-library JSON parsing and adds no dependency or lockfile change.

extension_decision.rationale: This tightens the existing V8 protocol rather than adding an application extension surface.

data_ownership.rationale: The preregistration is authoritative for budgets and frozen inputs; the collection record only reports matched values actually used.

error_model.rationale: Malformed, missing, non-numeric, mismatched, symlinked, dirty, external, or stale committed inputs are explicit preflight errors, distinct from Agent or hidden-test timeouts.

contract_evolution.rationale: V8 has no trials, so the planned envelope can be strengthened and recommitted before collection without rewriting completed evidence.

operational_budget.rationale: The Agent and hidden-test deadlines, plus the exact Codex release, become immutable limits instead of mutable collection choices.

threat_boundary.rationale: The offline protocol rejects common local input substitution paths but remains an evaluation boundary, not a security sandbox against a hostile user with filesystem control.

delivery_lifecycle.rationale: Protocol, tests, documentation, evidence, verification, review, and the new preregistration commit remain one atomic scope before trials.

release_recovery.rationale: No production service or rollout is affected.

data_migration.rationale: No schema, persistence format, or user data changes.

configuration_secrets.rationale: Timeouts and the Codex version are non-secret protocol configuration with one authoritative value; no credentials are recorded.

dependency_supply_chain.rationale: No dependency is added, removed, or updated.

operational_knowledge.rationale: README and the evaluation reference state the frozen limits, worktree gate, archive snapshot, and the reason an unregistered or substituted input cannot support a result.

reproducibility.rationale: A future collector can reproduce the exact deadlines, Codex release, inputs, and runner validation from the committed preregistration; the package-level QuixBugs replay additionally requires the documented pytest environment.

independent_review.reviewer: Codex native independent review: v8_final_protocol_review and v8_release_review
independent_review.notes: After the evidence refresh, separate current-byte protocol and release reviews both approved the staged-runtime fix, preregistration hashes, evidence chain, and release readiness.

supporting_artifacts.summary: Focused V8 traps, full suite, static analysis, Skill validation, and planned-state analyzer outputs.

remaining_risks: No V8 paired Agent trial has run, so no Skill-effect claim is supported.
The future result remains scoped to the fixed model, Harness, held-out corpus, and blind scorer rather than all model behavior.
The package-level external QuixBugs replay requires pytest from the normal Python environment; its absence under PYTHONNOUSERSITE is documented rather than treated as V8 evidence.

causal.symptom: V8 could validate a mutable collection envelope while still allowing delayed live runtime imports, symbolic-link tree substitution, stale Harness identity, input replacement, or a staged executor that scored from the live worktree.
causal.discriminating_check: Regression tests deliberately supply mismatched budgets, a wrong Codex version, input and output symlinks, dirty worktrees, external paths, stale commit bytes, post-validation source replacement, a preflight runtime-import trap, and a scorer whose live reload raises; each invalid path must fail before an Agent is launched or before hidden scoring can consume a live file.
causal.upstream_path: command-line inputs -> V8 bootstrap -> frozen preregistration and worktree validation -> archive snapshot -> staged runtime import -> delegated paired execution and hidden scoring -> effect-analysis eligibility
causal.timeline_evidence: V7 was archived after incomplete pairs and baseline global-Skill reads; V8 was initially prepared with a stale Codex version and mutable preflight surface before these gates were added.

evidence_artifacts.summary: Executed V8 trap tests, normal-environment package verification, static analysis, Skill validation, planned-state analysis, and the constrained-environment pytest limitation.
Source for deterministic input-substitution, symbolic-link, and staged-runtime-no-live-reload counterfactual tests.

hypotheses.claim: A mutable or substituted collection input makes the V8 effect envelope ineligible.
hypotheses.prediction: Each registered preflight trap is rejected before the delegated runner can launch an Agent.

hypotheses.claim: The new execution gates prevent the tested protocol-drift paths during formal collection.
hypotheses.prediction: A frozen worktree preflight will accept only the committed bytes and installed Harness version.
